$description: What each Figma token is for: its $description, laid over tokens/foundations.tokens.json by the build (the drawing-based pull carries none). Keyed by CSS name; a key ending in -* describes a whole primitive ramp. Every token has a description, here or in its own hand-written file (tests/token-names.test.mjs). In phase 2 these move into Figma's variable descriptions.
--gv-color-slate-*: Slate, the cool grey ramp: neutral text, icons, borders and surfaces. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-neutral-*: Neutral, the pure greys from white to near-black. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-navy-*: Navy, Go Vocal's brand hue. A primitive named by its hue, so 'brand' stays a role a city can take over. Semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-alpha-*: A colour with transparency, for tints and scrims. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-teal-*: Teal, the accent and info hue. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-green-*: Green, the success hue and a chart colour. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-amber-*: Amber, the warning hue. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-red-*: Red, the danger hue and a chart colour. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-orange-*: Orange, chart colours only. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-blue-*: Blue, the categorical chart ramp. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-color-olive-*: Olive, a chart colour. A primitive: semantic tokens point here; components never paint with it.
--gv-surface-app: The page behind everything: the back office's background around panels.
--gv-surface-panel: The default surface: panels, cards, menus, popovers, fields, modals. White.
--gv-surface-secondary: A surface a step off white, inside a panel: a modal's footer, a drop zone, a stat card, a toolbar.
--gv-surface-tertiary: A light grey stage under a group of panels or specimens: a phone preview's backdrop, the Foundations specimens. Same value as surface-hovered; pick by meaning.
--gv-surface-hovered: A neutral row, item or quiet button under the pointer (data-hovered). Same value as surface-tertiary; pick by meaning.
--gv-surface-pressed: A neutral row, item or quiet button pressed (data-pressed); also an open trigger, the current tree item and a selected list item. Same value as surface-app and surface-neutral; pick by meaning.
--gv-surface-info: An info tint: an info Badge or Banner, a drop target, the AI tint. Text on it is text-info, icons icon-info.
--gv-surface-backdrop: The scrim behind a modal dialog.
--gv-surface-neutral: The neutral tint of a pill or track: a Badge, a Segmented control's track, a meter's empty track, a pill Select, an avatar with no picture. Text on it is text-neutral.
--gv-surface-accent-strong: The solid accent fill of a measure: a meter's or progress bar's value, vote progress.
--gv-surface-success: A success tint: a success Toast, a live status. Text on it is text-success-strong.
--gv-surface-brand-strong: The solid brand fill: a primary Button, a coachmark, the current page in Pagination, an avatar's initials. Text on it is text-inverse.
--gv-surface-selected-strong: The solid fill of something checked or selected: a checked Checkbox, a selected menu box, a selected tag or token, a focused date segment. Text and ticks on it are inverse.
--gv-surface-neutral-strong: The solid neutral fill: a Switch that is off, an upcoming phase's dot.
--gv-surface-danger-strong: The solid danger fill: a danger Button, the New dot, a count of new items, an invalid Switch.
--gv-side-nav-surface: Side nav only (component tier): its dark navy background.
--gv-side-nav-surface-current: Side nav only: the current item's background.
--gv-side-nav-icon: Side nav only: an item's icon.
--gv-side-nav-icon-current: Side nav only: the current item's icon.
--gv-text-primary: The default text: headings, labels, values, everything that isn't secondary.
--gv-text-body: Long reading text: paragraphs in a description, a comment, an official update.
--gv-text-secondary: Supporting text: descriptions, meta, column headers, helper text.
--gv-text-tertiary: The quietest readable text: counts beside a label, timestamps, a separator dot. Same value as text-placeholder; pick by meaning.
--gv-text-disabled: Text in a control that can't be used.
--gv-text-neutral: Text on surface-neutral: a neutral Badge, a Segmented control's items, a pill Select.
--gv-text-success-strong: Success words on surface-success: a success Toast's title and action, a live status.
--gv-text-success: Success words on the panel: reviewed, done.
--gv-text-inverse: Text on a strong fill: surface-brand-strong, surface-inverse, surface-danger-strong.
--gv-text-placeholder: A field's placeholder. Same value as text-tertiary; pick by meaning.
--gv-text-link: A link's words. Hovered: text-link-hovered; pressed: text-link-pressed.
--gv-border-control: The border of a field or control: Text field, Select, Checkbox, Radio, an outlined Button.
--gv-border-control-hovered: A field or control's border under the pointer.
--gv-border-default: The default border of a container: cards, menus, popovers, tables, tabs, panels, the side panel.
--gv-border-subtle: A quiet line: a divider inside a panel, a list's separators.
--gv-border-row: The faintest line: between table rows.
--gv-border-strong: A neutral border a step darker than default: a Switch's edge, a Choice card, an empty state's dashed frame.
--gv-border-selected: The edge of something selected or checked: a selected Choice card, a checked box, the current tab's line, a drop target.
--gv-border-inverse: A ring that separates a shape from a busy or dark fill: overlapping avatars.
--gv-icon-primary: An icon beside primary text, or one that is the main thing in its control.
--gv-icon-secondary: An icon beside secondary text: the default in rows, menus and toolbars.
--gv-icon-tertiary: A quiet icon: a field's leading icon, a breadcrumb separator.
--gv-icon-quiet: The quietest icon: chevrons that open or move, a sort mark. A disabled icon is icon-disabled (same value).
--gv-icon-inverse: An icon on a strong fill (surface-brand-strong, surface-inverse, surface-danger-strong).
--gv-space-2: A hairline gap: between an icon and its badge, stacked lines of a label.
--gv-space-4: A tight gap: inside small controls, between an icon and its text in a pill.
--gv-space-6: A small gap: a popover's padding, icon to label in a button.
--gv-space-8: The default small gap: between controls in a row, a menu item's padding.
--gv-space-10: A control's inline padding: fields, Select, a toolbar.
--gv-space-12: The default gap inside a card or row; a Button's inline padding.
--gv-space-16: A panel's padding; the gap between rows of controls.
--gv-space-20: A card's padding; the gap between groups in a form.
--gv-space-24: A panel's or modal's padding; the gap between sections.
--gv-space-32: The gap between page sections; a page's padding.
--gv-space-48: A large page gap: around an empty state, between page regions.
--gv-space-56: A very large gap: a page header's room.
--gv-space-104: Title field's clear zone (on the 8 grid).
--gv-radius-2: The smallest corner: a focus ring around text, a tiny mark.
--gv-radius-4: A small corner: a Checkbox, a tag, a tooltip.
--gv-radius-6: A compact control's corner: a small icon button, a toast's ×.
--gv-radius-8: The default corner: buttons, fields, menus, rows, cards inside a panel.
--gv-radius-10: Figma's control radius for larger controls.
--gv-radius-12: A container's corner: panels, popovers, cards, toasts.
--gv-radius-22: The phone preview's corner (a drawing, not UI).
--gv-radius-full: A pill or a circle: badges, avatars, dots, a Switch.
--gv-type-stat: Big numbers: KPI tiles, stat rows. 28/32 Regular.
--gv-type-stat-small: Small number tiles and counts in rows. 20/24 Medium.
--gv-type-title: Panel, modal and dashboard card titles. 16/24 Medium.
--gv-type-body-strong: Emphasised body: an alert dialog's title, a metric's label. 14/20 Medium.
--gv-type-body: Reading text: metric labels, banners, descriptions. 14/20 Regular.
--gv-type-ui-strong: Buttons, the current breadcrumb, a selected segment, a row's title. 13/20 Medium.
--gv-type-ui: The control text: list rows, cells, menu options, breadcrumbs, group titles. 13/20 Regular.
--gv-type-small-strong: Pills, the rail header, a phase name, a sorted column header. 12/16 Medium.
--gv-type-small: Captions and meta: card titles, To review and Required, rail labels. 12/16 Regular.
--gv-shadow-raised: Something that rests on a surface: a card, a menu, a popover, a selected segment's rest state.
--gv-shadow-raised-strong: A raised shape a step stronger: the selected item of a Segmented control.
--gv-shadow-overlay: Something that floats over the page: a modal, the side panel, a dialog.
--gv-surface-inverse: The near-black fill that inverts the page: a Switch that is on, a selected toggle button. Text and icons on it are text-inverse and icon-inverse.
--gv-space-40: A section's padding on a page, an empty state's room.
